optimization.denominator: expected number of scored windows of that view and horizon in a batch; fixed before every microbatch so accumulation is boundary independent

selection.note: count, load and the preserved v0312 packet-joint score never select a checkpoint

targets.name: count
targets.distribution: negative binomial on the exposure-integrated rate
targets.support: every valid window, including zero-event windows
targets.role: trained and monitored; not in the main selection

targets.name: shaft_composition
targets.distribution: multinomial given the total participating contacts
targets.support: windows with at least one participating contact
targets.role: trained; enters the main selection at h=30
targets.conditioning: conditioned on the total participation count, not on the number of events

targets.name: band_ratio
targets.support: event-time paths with a finite original component
targets.weight: w_h/3 shared by the three morphology families
targets.role: trained; enters the main selection at h=30

targets.name: signed_xlag
targets.support: event-time paths with a finite original component
targets.role: trained; enters the main selection at h=30

targets.name: delay_iqr
targets.distribution: point mass at exact zero plus a Normal on the standardised log
targets.support: events with a finite delay IQR
targets.role: trained; enters the main selection at h=30

targets.name: total_load
targets.distribution: Normal on the FIT-standardised log total load
targets.support: windows with at least one event
targets.role: trained and monitored; not in the main selection

targets.name: current_packet_reconstruction
targets.role: no independent target exists; the h=1 target is the next minute, not a reconstruction

targets.name: conditional_identity / continuation / seizure
targets.role: never in the producer loss and never in checkpoint selection

morphology_estimator.per_component: -log mean_s p(y_bik | z_s) on the event-time prediction path
order: mean over the valid components of a family
equal weight over the families present for that event
equal weight over the events with morphology support in the window
equal weight over the windows with at least one scorable event
morphology_estimator.companion: event-equal-weight Delta_event is reported alongside the window-equal-weight main effect
morphology_estimator.zero_event_windows: score the count target; conditional morphology is not applicable and is not zero-filled

preserved_legacy.name: legacy_packet_joint_component_score
preserved_legacy.definition: the v0312 rule: sum every event and component log-probability inside the packet, mix over paths once, normalise by the total valid component count
preserved_legacy.status: monitored only; never divided by an event count and renamed as the new estimator

transforms.delay_iqr: FIT median/IQR of log positive values, with an explicit zero mass
transforms.total_load: FIT median/IQR of the log total load
transforms.packet_inputs: FIT median/IQR per column, clipped to +-8
transforms.conditions: FIT median/IQR of the continuous entries only; flags are never rescaled

conditions.layout: intraday sin/cos at the evaluation time, then the query-time condition vector
